header.title: Welcome to BabelVoice
header.sub: About two minutes to finish basic setup.
header.skipConfirm: Skip onboarding? You can re-run it from Settings → Advanced.

step1.title: Install the audio driver
step1.desc: macOS does not let apps pipe audio between each other directly. A virtual audio driver acts as the bridge so meeting apps can receive translated speech. The system asks for your password once during install.

status.installing: Installing. Enter your admin password in the system prompt and allow install.
status.installedAlive: Installed and registered as a system audio output device.
status.installedWaiting: Installed. Waiting for the system to recognize it…

step1.doneBanner: Driver registered as a system audio output device

step2.title: Grant required permissions
step2.desc: Microphone permission is used to translate your speech. Screen-recording permission is used to capture meeting audio (macOS groups system audio under it). One-time authorization.

mic.title: Microphone
mic.desc: Click the button on the right and choose "Allow" in the system prompt.

screen.title: Screen recording (for meeting-audio capture)
screen.desc: macOS groups system-audio capture under screen recording. Click to authorize, then allow it in the system prompt.
screen.fallbackHint: After granting permission in System Settings, fully quit and relaunch BabelVoice for it to take effect.

step2.tip: If the system prompt did not appear, the request may have been denied previously. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen Recording, find BabelVoice, enable it, then <bold>fully quit</bold> and relaunch the app.

step3.title: Configure a translation service
step3.desc: Choose a translation provider and paste the key. Connectivity is verified immediately.
step3.savedHintDoubao: Key encrypted on this device (App Key ••••{{tail}})

step4.title: Test speak (ZH → EN)
step4.desc: Verify the forward path: your Chinese speech is translated to English and played through the speaker. Once this works, the other party will hear the translated voice in the meeting.

card.title: Say a sentence in Chinese (ZH → EN)
card.desc: Click and say a Chinese sentence — e.g. "你好世界" or "今天天气真不错". This step is fixed at Chinese-to-English; the speaker plays the English translation. Adjust language pairs in Settings → Translation.

errors.speakTimeout: No translation in 30 seconds. Check the microphone and retry.

step5.title: Test listen (EN → ZH)
step5.desc: Verify the reverse path: {{deviceName}} captures a sample English clip from system audio and produces Chinese subtitles in real time.

card.title: Play sample English (EN → ZH)
card.desc: A sample English clip is played. {{deviceName}} captures it from system audio and shows the Chinese subtitle below.

errors.listenTimeout: No Chinese subtitle in 15 seconds. Confirm system-audio permission and retry.

step6.title: Set BabelVoice as the microphone in your meeting app
step6.desc: In Zoom, Tencent Meeting, Lark, Teams, etc., change the microphone input to BabelVoice. The other party will then hear the translated voice.
